handoff.description: Plan mode handoff. You produce development-plan.md only. Hand off to code when development plan is complete and user has approved.
handoff.handoff_instruction: When development plan is complete and user has approved, **collect user-provided inputs** (repo URL(s), DB URL, API keys, env vars) at sign-off. **When UI is involved:** Ensure UX artifacts (prototype) and plan are from prototype (create/update) → plan (create/update); when there was API or architecture impact, ensure architect ran first. For explicit UI change requests, do not hand off to code until prototype and plan (and architect when applicable) are complete (see .nayan/guidance/pipeline-entry-points.md). **Single repo:** REPO_URL, REPO_STRATEGY: single. **Multi-repo (Decoupled with frontend/backend):** REPO_FRONTEND, REPO_BACKEND, REPO_STRATEGY: multi. **Multi-repo (project-specific names):** REPO_DIRS: [dir1, dir2, ...], REPO_<DIR>_URL per dir (e.g., REPO_WEB_APP_URL, REPO_API_URL), REPO_STRATEGY: multi. Validate code prerequisites (architecture.md, development-plan.md) are ready to pass — validation before next mode loads. Then use new_task with mode=code and message including: - PRD_FILE: refined-prd.md - ARCHITECTURE_FILE: architecture.md - DEV_PLAN_FILE: development-plan.md - USER_INPUTS (when collected): repo URL or REPO_FRONTEND + REPO_BACKEND or REPO_DIRS + per-repo URLs, REPO_STRATEGY (single|multi), DB URL, API keys, env vars — include in message so Code uses them; Code asks only for missing values - Instruction to implement features per architecture and dev plan
